usages.explain: 「捲る（まくる）」expresses the meaning of "to do a lot", different from 「すぎる」 which means "to do too much". Used to describe actions that are done excessively, disorganized, or illogically and are repeated.

examples.content: ベトナムにいた時はビールを飲みまくっていた。
examples.transcription: べとなむにいたときはびーるをのみまくっていた。
examples.mean: When I was in Vietnam, I drank a lot of beer.

examples.content: 会うたびに砂糖さんはしゃべりまくるんだ
examples.transcription: あうたびにさとうさんはしゃべりまくるんだ
examples.mean: Every time we meet, Mr. Sugar talks a lot.

title: 捲る => to do over and over again; to do relentlessly; non-stop; constantly; keep doing
